users_email_uq.name: users_email_uq
users_email_uq.where: "users"."email" is not null and "users"."deleted_at" is null

tasks_source_message_uq.name: tasks_source_message_uq
tasks_source_message_uq.where: "tasks"."source_message_id" is not null and "tasks"."deleted_at" is null

tasks_source_note_uq.name: tasks_source_note_uq
tasks_source_note_uq.where: "tasks"."source_note_id" is not null and "tasks"."deleted_at" is null

tasks_due_idx.name: tasks_due_idx
tasks_due_idx.where: "tasks"."deleted_at" is null and "tasks"."archived_at" is null and "tasks"."status" <> 'done'

calendar_events_timing.name: calendar_events_timing
calendar_events_timing.value:
("calendar_events"."all_day" and "calendar_events"."start_date" is not null and "calendar_events"."starts_at" is null and ("calendar_events"."end_date" is null or "calendar_events"."end_date" >= "calendar_events"."start_date"))
       or (not "calendar_events"."all_day" and "calendar_events"."starts_at" is not null and ("calendar_events"."ends_at" is null or "calendar_events"."ends_at" > "calendar_events"."starts_at"))

notifications_dedupe_uq.name: notifications_dedupe_uq
notifications_dedupe_uq.where: "notifications"."dedupe_key" is not null and "notifications"."read_at" is null

messages_attachment_idx.name: messages_attachment_idx
messages_attachment_idx.where: "messages"."attachment_id" is not null and "messages"."deleted_at" is null
